{"title":"Knee-friendly 18+ week fat-loss & toning plan (3 phases, 3–4 days/week)","content":"### Overview (what the final deliverable will include)
- **3 phases** (Weeks 1–6, 7–12, 13–18+) with clear goals and progression.
- **3–4 sessions/week**, each **45–60 minutes**, using **24 Hour Fitness equipment + home bands + 5/10 lb dumbbells**.
- Each session specified with **warm-up, main lifts (compound emphasis), accessories, low-impact cardio**, plus **sets/reps/rest**, **RPE/effort targets**, and **progression rules**.
- **Knee-friendly substitutions** (no/low impact options; hinge-dominant and glute/hamstring emphasis; controlled knee-dominant patterns).
- A **progression system** (double progression, load/rep targets, deload guidance, and weekly cardio progression).

### Task decomposition rationale
- Parallelize the work into (1) evidence-based guardrails, (2) resistance training design, (3) low-impact cardio design, then (4) integrate into a week-by-week phased plan and (5) final QA and packaging.
